hero.lede: I build digital healthcare at doktor.se — real-time patient apps, Node.js services, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes on AWS. I own features from the first sketch to the server they run on, and I have shipped my own game on Steam.

about.statement: I don't stop at my layer. I follow a problem through the UI, the API, the database and the cloud — until it's solved for real.

role.title: Full Stack Developer
role.text: doktor.se is a Swedish digital healthcare provider. I work across the patient apps, the microservices behind them, the cloud platform and the analytics — and take features from idea to production.

realtime.title: Real-time systems
realtime.summary: Features that update the moment something happens — in the patient app, in internal tools and in servers I built myself.
realtime.p1: The patient app listens to WebSocket events: new, cancelled and moved bookings update the UI and refresh the inbox instantly.
realtime.p2: Built a WebSocket server in Node.js (ws + Express) with broadcast chat, live user presence and logout notifications.
realtime.p3: Picked Server-Sent Events with heartbeats and auto-reconnect for a service that sleeps when idle — and documented why it beats WebSockets there.

auth.title: Auth service, built from scratch
auth.summary: A standalone Node.js service that owns accounts, sign-in and live collaboration for an internal admin platform.
auth.p1: Fastify with response schemas, so password hashes can never leak out of an endpoint by mistake.
auth.p2: Signed, expiring tokens, scrypt password hashing and verified webhook signatures.
auth.p3: Moved accounts from a file on disk to PostgreSQL — fixing users that vanished when the app ran on several containers.

cloud.title: Cloud & infrastructure
cloud.summary: Moved the public doktor.se website to Kubernetes and built the AWS infrastructure around it as code.
cloud.p1: Migration to AWS EKS with GitOps deploys through Flux — Git decides what runs in production.
cloud.p2: AWS CDK stacks with Lambda functions and a verified mail domain in SES.
cloud.p3: Runtime configuration and security-scan fixes, so one container image runs safely in every environment.

services.title: Microservices & APIs
services.summary: Work across several Node.js services in a microservice architecture — from SQL to API gateway.
services.p1: Clinic availability endpoint with SQL queries and tests in the booking service.
services.p2: SMS and transactional email: API routes, templates and a tool for partner pharmacies to message patients.
services.p3: Server-side feature flags, and product data carried from service to admin panel to patient app.

admin.title: Vaccination admin platform
admin.summary: An internal tool where staff run a nationwide vaccination service — built on top of a headless CMS.
admin.p1: Editors manage clinics, prices and campaigns, with bulk edit and image upload.
admin.p2: Conflict detection when two people edit the same clinic, and schema validation before every write.
admin.p3: Automation: campaigns expire on their own, opening hours sync, clinics import in bulk from spreadsheets.

inbox.title: App inbox, end to end
inbox.summary: A new inbox in the patient app, from API client to screens to live updates.
inbox.p1: Inbox screens with unread badge, multi-select and delete.
inbox.p2: Unread count refreshes live when booking events arrive over WebSockets.
inbox.p3: Fixed CORS preflight in the API gateway so the web app could reach the new service.

analytics.title: Privacy-first analytics
analytics.summary: Product analytics and session replay in the patient care flow — without exposing sensitive health data.
analytics.p1: Event tracking across a multi-step care flow.
analytics.p2: Session replay that masks text and blocks images, video and uploads.
analytics.p3: Remote rollout control with feature flags, prepared for privacy and legal review.

media.title: Rich media in conversations
media.summary: Patients can send video and view media full screen in their conversations with clinicians.
media.p1: Video support in the upload widget.
media.p2: Full-screen image and video preview with swipe and arrow navigation.

ownership.title: Own it end to end
ownership.text: From the database schema to the pixel the user sees — and the deploy in between.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.text: Design so mistakes are impossible, not just unlikely.

measure.title: Measure, then decide
measure.text: Ship with tracking and feature flags, and let data guide the next step.

clarity.title: Leave it clearer
clarity.text: Comments that explain why, and guides that help the next developer move faster.

game.description: Aria Disconnect is an action-adventure Metroidvania with a cyberpunk theme. You are going to follow Heri's journey to recover from the digital nightmare he has become stuck inside. The year is 2082, you are hooked to a machine, and there is only one way out, to disconnect.
